beforeFix.failure: The preview document shared the application origin when opened directly, so script could read local project storage.

hostilePreviewActions.image: request failed with csp; img-src violation recorded
hostilePreviewActions.script: request failed with csp; script-src violation recorded
hostilePreviewActions.test: tests/e2e/sites-preview-csp.spec.ts: an untrusted preview cannot send data to an external origin

reproduction: Navigate directly to /preview/?resource=button rather than through ResourcePreviewFrame.
Inspect window.origin and attempt localStorage.setItem from the preview document.
rootCause: Only the embedding iframe element imposed sandboxing; the preview response CSP did not sandbox direct navigations.
remediation: The Sites Worker preview CSP now includes sandbox allow-scripts, applying an opaque origin with scripts enabled to both embedded and directly opened preview documents.

tests.beforeFix: Direct-preview regression failed: expected opaque origin and blocked storage, received http://127.0.0.1:4323 with storage accessible.
tests.afterFix: 10 sites-preview-csp Playwright tests passed across desktop Chromium and mobile Chromium.
